title: TTC proposal: remove nine stops on the 512 St Clair streetcar
status_note: The TTC page calls this a proposal starting as early as March 15, 2026, with a survey that closed January 30, 2026. The stops are still in the November 2026 schedule file, so it may not have happened yet. Check with the TTC.
quotes: Starting as early as March 15, 2026, the TTC is proposing a plan to remove nine stops along the 512 St Clair route.
Each stop adds up to thirty seconds to journey times. Removing closely spaced stops will improve travel times and increase service reliability.
